outcome.technical: audit-task.py gains the build-command verb: `build-command <key> (--command CMD [--replace] | --remove) [--reason TEXT|-]`. Door (cmd_build_command) refuses before the lock a key that is not one word, a key carrying a machine path (check_free_text), --remove with --command/--replace, no --command and no --remove, and a command judged by _machine_paths.executed_value_refusal under the field name the panel uses (meta.buildCommands), so the sentence is byte-identical to the panel's. _locked_build_command reads the plan (_read_plan), refuses an existing key without --replace naming its current value, refuses --replace and --remove of an absent key, refuses --remove naming each phase testGate / task tests.gate entry that names the key (_gate_holders, every status), writes through _write_plan (index_fields=meta, revalidated, rolled back on findings), and journals one buildcommand.change row with details field=meta.buildCommands.<key>, from, to, reason. Command text stored verbatim (a double-space/quote fixture asserted equal). Wired: usage block, VERB_FLAGS row, parser choices + --command (dest build_command, because dest `command` is the verb word) / --replace / --remove, doors map, commands/task.md (description, argument-hint, a short subcommand section), README /audit:task row. Tests: new stage bcm-block (bcm1, bcm2, titled with the tests.add clauses verbatim after the case id), plus the existing derived grids extended for the new verb in test_audit_task.py (vf grid _vf_pos, vf4 _vf_ok, tw5 _tw_argv). Cross-file lints made me edit two files outside `files`: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (test__deps e1 requires a code span naming the verb under the audit-task.py section; added a paragraph) and plugins/audit/tests/test__refs.py (tk1 regex now admits a hyphenated verb, tk3 and pf2 enumerations list build-command); the plan gate allowed both writes. commands/task.md body is held under the measure-context ceiling, so the section there is four lines and the detail lives in the README row and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md. Results: test_audit_task.py 1082/1082, test__refs.py 286/286, test__deps.py 244/244, whole sweep 340/340 files ok (16400 cases) in the task tree, ruff clean, vermin clean, gate-parity and measure-context --gate OK. Additions beyond the spec text, stated: an optional --reason (the spec journals 'the reason' but names no flag for it), and refusal of --replace/--remove on an absent key. --remove checks only phase testGate and task tests.gate as specified, not meta.fullGate or meta.phaseGate.always, which can also name a key.
outcome.descriptive: A new audit-task.py build-command verb adds, replaces or removes one meta.buildCommands key on an existing plan without the panel's browser session, with the panel's machine-path refusal, a refusal that names the current value or the gate entry holding the key, and one journal row per write.
